description:
Scope: tests only for lib/zaq/ingestion/chunk_languages.ex uncovered lines 27, 50, 67, 77. No production change, new Action, browser spec, or numerical coverage claim. Functional contract: global (not permission-filtered) DB language inventory, ETS cache with invalidation/TTL, direct DB fallback when the process is absent, safe empty result before table provisioning, and explicit SQL error propagation. Action reuse: not applicable — adds tests only, changes no executable operation; exercise existing ChunkLanguages.list/invalidate, Chunk/Document APIs and Repo instead of a parallel implementation. Candidate API evidence: ChunkLanguages @moduledoc, Chunk.create/delete_by_document, Ingestion supervisor and existing chunk_languages_test.exs. Owner: existing test/zaq/ingestion/chunk_languages_test.exs; keep use Zaq.DataCase, async: false because process registry and transactional table DDL are shared VM/DB resources.

Test-first scenarios (one concern/test each, exact file test/zaq/ingestion/chunk_languages_test.exs):
1) line 50, live server cached hit. Ensure table via Chunk.create_table(1536) and running ChunkLanguages server; use existing server or start_supervised! only if absent, with Sandbox.allow as needed. Create Document with unique source and Chunk.create language french; invalidate then synchronize with _ = :sys.get_state(pid) (PubSub delivery may be asynchronous, so ensure the invalidation has been processed). Assert first list contains french. Use Repo.update_all for that chunk to switch language to german WITHOUT calling Chunk API/invalidate, assert second list still contains french and not german, proving valid ETS hit. Call invalidate; synchronize on server state; assert list contains german and not french (only compare test-owned unique chunks or exact list if empty DB is guaranteed). Avoid sleeps/ETS internals or waiting for TTL.
2) line 27, no registered process fallback. In an isolated test only, stop the app-owned child with Supervisor.terminate_child(Zaq.Ingestion.Supervisor, Zaq.Ingestion.ChunkLanguages) (if no app-owned child, handle test-started child correctly), assert Process.whereis(ChunkLanguages) == nil, create one persisted french chunk, assert ChunkLanguages.list() includes french; directly update language to german through Repo.update_all and assert subsequent list includes german and excludes french, demonstrating no stale ETS. Register on_exit restart_child and assert recovery, including when assertion fails; do not kill an unrelated registered process or start two processes under same name. This case depends on test roles/supervision: check child spec before implementing. Run isolated from other test modules that access global inventory; async:false alone does not prevent concurrent async modules from observing the temporary absence. If safe isolation cannot be guaranteed in broad runs, run this scenario in an isolated test-run process with test role controls instead of disabling a shared supervised process in the full suite; record blocker, do not add a production test hook.
3) line 67, missing public.chunks. In dedicated isolated DataCase test, terminate registered server as above for direct fallback, execute Repo.query!("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS chunks") within sandbox ownership (Postgres transactional DDL restores shared schema on rollback), assert Repo.query!("SELECT to_regclass('public.chunks')").rows == [[nil]], assert ChunkLanguages.list() == []; do not call Chunk.create_table within this case or drop/recreate globally outside a transaction. Use on_exit server restart only after sandbox transaction rollback/owner cleanup, otherwise it must not query the dropped table. Be alert to concurrent tests reading chunks: execute in isolated invocation or ensure DB-level isolation is proved. Existing precedent test/zaq/ingestion/fts_backend_test.exs:110 and :239 drops chunks in sandbox.
4) line 77, SQL failure reported rather than treated as empty inventory. Again ensure no registered process; create a nested Repo.transaction (savepoint inside DataCase sandbox), issue a deterministic SQL error Repo.query("SELECT 1/0") and assert error, then inside the aborted transaction assert_raise RuntimeError matching "Cannot discover chunk languages:" when ChunkLanguages.list() hits Repo.query("SELECT to_regclass('public.chunks')") returning {:error, Postgrex.Error}; allow nested transaction to roll back. Do not induce flaky timeouts or alter global Repo config; check Ecto behavior for failed transaction before writing final assertion. Assert that a subsequent list after rollback returns normal results, proving recovery. If sandbox nested transaction raises rather than returns {:error}, investigate a deterministic connection-scoped SQL error under public contract without introducing production test seams.

Helpers/mocks: reuse DataCase sandbox, Chunk.create_table/1, Document.create/1, Chunk.create/1, supervised ChunkLanguages, and Sandbox.allow/3 already in this file; use minimal private test helpers only if duplicated lifecycle setup becomes meaningful. No Mox/external APIs, no network, no new production functions or test hooks. Time control: TTL untouched, cache-hit proof uses direct SQL update; PubSub state barrier after invalidate, not sleeps/polling. No property test required: finite four control-flow cases; property testing language-set normalization could be a separate task if broad inputs are changed, but no logic is changing.

Validation for implementer (NOT performed by planner): run isolated mix test test/zaq/ingestion/chunk_languages_test.exs and relevant ingestion regression tests, mix q through Context Mode per issue validation; review full-suite concurrency of global process/DDL before relying on isolated success. After review-approved implementation, defer numerical coverage to coverage-upper handoff, then final mix precommit per workflow; this planning request explicitly forbids running them now. No E2E authoring: no feature/UI change; existing ingestion E2E execution assessed under workflow when implementation affects ingestion behavior (test-only work does not). Documentation updates: none; issue and eventual PR validation record only. Existing issue zaq-5qu concerns ingestion.ex and browser, not these ChunkLanguages branches; no dependency. Single test surface and one step, so one issue/DAG single root zaq-uhi.
title: [zaq-uhi] Cover ChunkLanguages fallback, cache hit, absent table and query error
